description: The ways bytes go out of the board and come in: a BLE characteristic, a UART port.

commands.label: Remove a provider
commands.description: Removes a provider no one uses (not the board's own).

fields.label: Link
fields.description: Which driver made the provider (UART, BLE)

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Its address on that link: BLE the characteristic's 16-bit UUID, UART the port

returns.label: Number of providers
returns.description: Then per provider: its id (link u8, channel u32), max frame u16 (0 = down), state u8 (SYS_DATA_PROVIDER_STATE_*).

commands.label: Send on a provider
commands.description: Sends one frame on a provider no user has opened.

fields.label: Link
fields.description: Which driver made the provider (UART, BLE)

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Its address on that link: BLE the characteristic's 16-bit UUID, UART the port
